Subject: Vendor setup: wiring, tax forms, and marketplace listing

Hi Vivek,

We're getting ready to go live with Redwood on our AWS Marketplace listing and need to complete vendor setup and PO routing. Can you confirm:

- The vendor intake form and required tax docs (W-9 / W-8BEN)
- Bank wiring template for direct deposit (wire vs ACH?)
- Who receives the PO and invoices for marketplace transactions
- Any DocuSign contract steps for Marketplace SaaS integration
- Typical lead time from paperwork submitted to vendor activation

I've attached our intake template for reference (vendor_intake_template.pdf).

Thanks,

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: wiring, tax forms, and marketplace listing

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the template. Overview and action items below.

Summary of what we need from Starlite to activate vendor and accept POs/payments:

1) Vendor intake form (complete the attached PDF or use our online form).
2) US tax docs: W-9 for US entity, W-8BEN for non-US. Please indicate tax country.
3) Bank details: we accept ACH (domestic USD) and wire (SWIFT). Use the Redwood banking template below:
   - Account name: Redwood Inference Inc.
   - Bank: Pacific Gateway Bank
   - Routing (ACH): 123456789
   - SWIFT: PGATUS33
   - Account number: 987654321
4) Marketplace contract: AWS Marketplace SaaS contract will be sent via DocuSign after vendor intake completes — see link: https://docusign.com/txn/abcdef1234567890
5) PO and invoices: please route POs to invoices@redwood.com and include the Deal ID in the PO lines (DEAL-9721). Invoices should reference the PO number and be sent to invoices@redwood.com with a CC to Vanessa for billing ops.
6) Lead times: paperwork → vendor activation typically 5–7 business days for standard cases; marketplace listing and entitlements can add 7–10 business days depending on AWS review queues.

Attachments: I attached our vendor packet (redwood_vendor_packet.zip) that contains a one-page vendor intake form, tax instructions, and sample invoice formatting.

Next steps / asks for Starlite:
- Please return the completed intake + tax doc.
- Confirm whether you can invoice in USD or require EUR/GBP (if EUR, share VAT number).
- If billing should be routed to a parent entity (Acme Global), confirm legal name and tax ID.

I've looped Vanessa (billing ops) for the PO routing and Ben (marketplace enablement) for the listing details — they'll jump in as needed.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Attachment stubs: redwood_vendor_packet.zip
